blocks.text: VIGAN CITY, Ilocos Sur — The upgraded Abel-Iloko Exhibition of the National Museum of the Philippines–Ilocos (NMP-Ilocos) opened here on Saturday, Sept. 19, highlighting the rich tradition of Ilocano weaving and the artisans who keep the craft alive. Provincial Board Member Janina Medina-Fariñas, who represented Gov. Jerry Singson, attended the opening ceremony and underscored the importance of supporting local artisans and preserving traditional weaving as an integral part of Ilocano culture. National Museum of the Philippines–Luzon Director Dr. Michael Armand Canilao also conveyed a message of support from Sen. Loren Legarda for the Ilocano community and its cultural bearers.
